en: Monochrome postcard view of a European medieval town with intact city walls and multiple round defensive towers. In the center rises a tall, slender church spire, flanked by massive gate towers and smaller turrets. In the foreground is a park or promenade with trees and several people walking along a path toward the fortified old town. The image occupies the left portion of the card, leaving a blank margin on the right, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
